pr_title: backupccl: create type schema change jobs for restored types
pr_body:
Fixes #50322.

This commit teaches restore to create type schema change jobs for
restored type descriptors that were backed up in the middle of a type
schema change.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/52272)
I just moved it after, makes more sense anyway.

> Just to confirm: could a type have multiple type change jobs? If so, would 1 job finish processing all enums that are not at full capability yet?

For now we only need one job per type descriptor. That one job will do all of the processing for the type desc.

Also, do you spot anything in this PR that would cause `TestBackupRestoreTenant` to fail? I haven't looked into it too much yet, but the TC logs are saying that some migrations are failing.

> It looks like we can get rid of this now?

done

Ooh, thanks for the tip! I'll do that in the future, but I want to just merge this.

bors r=pbardea

issue_context.title: backupccl: backups need to create type schema change jobs
issue_context.body: When restoring a type descriptor, there could potentially be changes to the type in progress. The restore process will need to create the appropriate type schema change jobs when restoring these descriptors.
